standard.title: SOLID CARBIDE END MILLS WITH CONTINUOUS PARALLEL SHANK — SPECIFICATION
standard.description: This standard specifies the dimensions of solid carbide end mills with continuous parallel shank.
standard.scope: This standard specifies the dimensions of solid carbide end mills with continuous parallel shank.

certification.description: Conformity assessment and licensing are supported by the Bureau of Indian Standards Certification Marking scheme, with details administered directly by BIS under the BIS Act, 1986.
requirements: The raw solid carbide material must belong to chip removal group P or K in accordance with IS 2428. The specific application group and grade class (such as K40) are chosen at the manufacturer's discretion or subject to agreement.
End mills are designated by name, nominal cutting diameter, number of flutes (Z), carbide grade class, and the standard number. Example: 'End Mill 6.00 Z4 K40 IS 16136'.
Tolerances on both cutting diameters (d1) and shank diameters (d2) must conform strictly to standard ISO limits specified in IS 919 (Part 2).
Unless otherwise specified, end mills must be supplied with a right-hand helix combined with a right-hand cutting direction.
End mills with non-standard intermediate cutting diameters may be supplied subject to prior agreement between the manufacturer and the purchaser.
